scope: Read-only schema and host-transition preparation. No new Omitted controller, proof, compilation, remote job, source/ref edit, original-tool re-audit or large graph read.

notation.M: Exactly one of the two fixed FQNs below; never an arbitrary pointer supplied by the contract.
notation.N: Original normal record selected as original_normal_records[M].
notation.Q: Original schema-1 audit receipt for M, from its actual immutable attempt/receipt.json or the exact same accepted latest.json bytes.
notation.D: The exact declarations.json artifact in the same owned-audit attempt as Q.audit.source.
notation.A: Q.artifacts, a relative-path to SHA256 map, not a nested type_hash record.

exact_field_binding_table.fields: N = normal_records[M]; N.module, cache_schema, exit_code, command, source/object hashes, closure_signature
exact_field_binding_table.checks: N.module=M; schema=3; exit_code=0; canonical SHA equals the fixed row above. The original command contains the fixed Lean binary, -t0 -j1 -M11264 -DwarningAsError=true -DmaxRecDepth=50000 -DmaxHeartbeats=40000000, -o N.object, N.source. Link the original archive/member through its accepted manifest, not an arbitrary path or exit field.

exact_field_binding_table.fields: Q.schema, Q.module, Q.accepted, Q.source_sha256, Q.object_sha256, Q.compile_closure_signature; X.project[M]
exact_field_binding_table.checks: schema=1, module=M, accepted=true. All source/object SHA and closure values equal N. X.project[M].source/object and their SHA agree with N's original paths and hashes. Recompute Q.input_sha256 with the original json_digest over X. Bind X.toolchain and its Lean/checker/template/driver hashes to the accepted runtime/tools.

For these schema-3 roots the original driver checks external_check.status=PASSED_BATCH_PRE_POST, before=after=external_snapshot, and source/dependency closure signatures. Keep that original context and its original snapshot SHA. Native adoption/rebind metadata alone does not replace the root receipt.

exact_field_binding_table.purpose: Named replay for this same root
exact_field_binding_table.fields: Q.replay.command, exit_code, inputs_unchanged, log, log_sha256; Q.replay_binding
exact_field_binding_table.checks: command exactly [the pinned LEANCHECKER, '--verbose', M], exit=0, inputs_unchanged=true. Q.replay_binding must equal original replay_context(X), including native context when present. Bind log bytes to Q.replay.log_sha256 and A[Q.replay.log]. A reused successful replay may legitimately name an earlier attempt of this same root; do not force a new replay or accept another root's exit.

exact_field_binding_table.purpose: Owned audit process for this root
exact_field_binding_table.fields: Q.audit.command, exit_code, source, source_sha256, memory_mb, inputs_unchanged, log, log_sha256
exact_field_binding_table.checks: Bind the exact generated Audit.lean artifact to its hash and target substitution. Command is the pinned Lean binary with -t0 -j1, -M{memory_mb}, warningAsError=true, maxRecDepth=50000, maxHeartbeats=40000000, and exactly Q.audit.source. Require exit=0 and inputs_unchanged=true; log SHA and source SHA equal their A entries. Requested original audit memory is 11264.

exact_field_binding_table.purpose: Full owned inventory and declaration count
exact_field_binding_table.checks: Run/reuse the original offline parse_audit over the exact owned log with M and X.project keys. Inventory module=M; serialized names nonempty/unique and equal environment names; declaration names unique and exactly equal inventory; every declaration module=M, unsafe/partial/axiom=false, nonempty untruncated type and allowed transitive axioms. D counts/axiom counts equal both parsed output and Q.audit. No public-only filtering.

Derive the attempt from Q.audit.source's parent, not a free JSON pointer. Hash the original types.txt and declarations.json bytes against A. The original types.txt serialization is '

'.join(name+'
'+type for each D.declarations entry)+'
'. There is no emitted Q.audit.type_hash, per-declaration type_hash, raw AST or universe claim.

Exactly the two fixed FQNs; accepted=requested=2 and all_accepted=true; each summary count equals its own Q.audit.declaration_count. Summary is an index and cannot replace either original per-module receipt/process/artifact chain. Reused=true must still name the accepted existing receipt/artifacts.

exact_field_binding_table.fields: Future root acceptance's exact two-module index plus original archive manifest and task receipt
exact_field_binding_table.checks: The final acceptance must explicitly bind each exact M to its original receipt member/hash, fixed normal canonical-row hash, source/object/closure, replay log/process, owned log/process, declarations/types artifact hashes and actual count. It must bind the common two-root summary and exact job request/result. Preserve the original driver schema; this requirement does not assert that a new acceptance index or audit archive already exists.

original_format_limits: The 76f918 manifest has only RECORD_MAP.json and SELECTED_ORIGINAL_NORMAL_RECORDS.json. It does not itself contain old normal logs.

These original normal rows and their attempts have a log path but no log_sha256 field. Do not invent one or claim the 76f918 archive binds the old log bytes. If another accepted original archive supplies those logs, link that actual manifest separately without rerunning normal.
Q.compile_provenance is descriptive metadata and can default to 'private compilation'; it is not a substitute for the fixed original normal row.
The original audit driver writes project source/object snapshots, runtime/native context and import-name inventories. It does not emit Omitted v2's whole standard/native module/facet identity graph.

The generic Q.artifacts map contains replay.log, audit.log, Audit.lean, declarations.json and types.txt. It does not bind its own receipt or summary; the final received archive manifest/root acceptance must bind those separately.
Other original dependency modules remain old accepted inputs. Auditing the two roots does not mint separate owned-audit credit for the other 52 project modules.
